name: perf-prove-it
description: Dev tooling for the perf-prove-it skills. The shipped skill scripts have no runtime dependencies; the static audit resolves a parser from the repository it scans (typescript, then @babel/parser, then acorn) and falls back to a dependency-free lexical scan.
